captions.detailed: A compact laboratory monocular microscope featuring a heavy rectangular black base, a swept light-gray arm, and a black specimen stage with a small glass slide. The optical assembly includes a black vertical body tube, a rotating nosepiece turret, and a tilted light-gray eyepiece tube. On the side of the main vertical arm, separate coarse and fine focus knobs are mounted. The optical carriage slides vertically, the stage carriage slides horizontally from left to right, and both focus knobs rotate continuously on their axes.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact laboratory monocular microscope as an articulated 3D assembly. It must have a heavy rectangular base, a swept upright arm, a separate rectangular stage with a specimen slide, and a monocular optical tube with a rotating turret. Add independent coarse and fine focusing knobs on the side of the arm, and configure prismatic joints for the vertical optical carriage and the horizontal stage carriage, plus continuous rotational joints for the turret and both knobs.
captions.factory: The microscope is constructed by modeling a heavy base using a rounded box, from which a vertical support column and swept arm are extruded. The optical tube assembly is built using stacked cylinders of varying radii, combined with a rotated cylinder for the inclined eyepiece. The stage is created as a flat rectangular box with a glass slide on top. Prismatic joints are defined for the vertical travel of the optical body and the lateral travel of the stage. The coarse and fine focus knobs are modeled as fluted cylinders and attached to the arm using continuous rotational joints.
